judgment.notes: N001 is instantiated with k=n, A=E and positive a=s only after H^s(E)=0 is proved. Both s>n in the n≥1 branch and s>0 in the n=0 branch satisfy its exponent condition. Compactness is applied to actual open covers; grid diameters use the specified Euclidean metric. There are no E/M applications.

For n≥1 the finite grid has cost at most C n^(s/2)h^(s-n); for fixed δ>0 admissible h can tend to zero, giving zero content at every scale and hence zero measure. The extended-order conclusion D≤n follows from D≤s for all s>n without presupposing finite D. For n=0 the singleton has zero positive-exponent cost. The last finite ball cover proves finite content for arbitrary s,δ>0. Both clauses of N002 follow.

scope: Coverage is reviewer-reported; reading alone is not mathematical assessment.
